text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Autopage: High 5xx error-rate detected for service `inference-gateway` in prod-us-east. threshold breached: 5xx_rate > 10% for 2m. PagerDuty incident created and routed to rotation. ---

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert created (INC3832123456). Notifying rotation and escalation policy. :bell:

Alice Chen: ack — I'm on it, looking at logs now. Can everyone post if they're seeing customer reports?

Bob Singh: seeing spike right after the CLI deploy at ~3832123200. I'm going to attempt a rollback to previous revision. starting rollback now.

Carla Morales: running quick metric query:
```
query: avg:inference.gateway.5xx{env:prod,region:us-east}.rollup(sum,60)
result: 12.3% (2m ago) -> 3.1% (now?)
```
Looks like error burst coincides with that deploy. :eyes:

Dan (eng-oncall): if rollback doesn't cut it we should route a % of traffic to prod-eu1 as fallback. Command I use:
```
redwood route set-fallback --service inference-gateway --region eu1 --weight 20
```
Can someone prepare that button if needed.

Alice Chen: confirmed logs show repeated upstream `auth-proxy` 502s. sample log:
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:11Z] request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream=auth-proxy/timeout msg="GET /v1/user -> 502 Bad Gateway"
[2026-03-15T12:34:12Z] request_id=abc124 status=502 upstream=auth-proxy/read_failed
```

Bob Singh: rollback finished — reverted to `cli-deploy@20260315-1132`. scaling inference-gateway to 10 replicas as a precaution:
```
kubectl scale deploy inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=10
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC3832123456 acknowledged by Alice Chen at 3832123468. :white_check_mark:

Carla Morales: 5xx rate dropping: 5xx_rate -> 2.0% over last 2m. Some customers still hitting errors but majority recovering.

Dan (eng-oncall): enabled temporary circuit-breaker on auth-proxy in prod-us-east to fail fast for upstream timeouts (threshold=5s, retry=0). Config snippet:
```
upstream:
  auth-proxy:
    circuit_breaker:
      max_connections: 100
      max_pending_requests: 50
      max_requests: 1000
      max_retries: 0
```

Alice Chen: also set emergency rate-limit for signin route: `ratelimit: 20r/s` to reduce amplification while we monitor. Notifying SRE to watch for downstream customer queues.

Bob Singh: disabling the CI pipeline that cut the CLI deploy to avoid accidental re-trigger. :no_entry:

Carla Morales: setting a 30m watch window. If 5xx < 1% for 30m we can close. creating ticket: PM-1298 for postmortem and remediation actions.

Alice Chen: thanks team — I'll follow up with customer comms for the 8 customers who reported failures. assigning follow-ups to Bob and Carla. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Monitoring mode: stable -> watching. Last update noted at 3832123510. If error-rate rises above 4% autopage will re-fire.

Dan (eng-oncall): leaving handoff note for next oncall: rollback+scale+cb applied, watch EU routing plan if we see another spike. I'll attach runbook steps to the ticket.

Alice Chen: closing thread in 30m if no regression. Great work. :rocket:
